messages.subject: Re: Random slope Multilevel group analysis in Lavaan
parts: I wonder if it is possible to do random slope multilevel analysis in R, hopefully using lavaan.

In R, you can use multilevel / mixed-effects modeling packages like nlme or lme4.
But lavaan does not offer random slopes.  It will probably be on the list of future plans for a long time:
https://lavaan.ugent.be/about/development.html
